SQLite public-domain dedication

The SQLite source code bundled by `libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2` is in the public
domain. The amalgamation carries the following blessing in place of a legal
notice:

May you do good and not evil.
May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

The Rust wrapper remains separately covered by its declared license in
`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. This statement does not place RadishMemory itself in
the public domain.
